name: Oscillatus Zero
source:
"Don't you know... About me...?"
I have lost all the memories about myself.

My life restarted in a certain hospital, with an 
accompanying beautiful agent. However,
this peaceful days was suddenly broken 
by a supernatural ability user...

Schemed sins, bloody lies and...
The love between two passing by each other.

Their fates will be altered by the complicated conspiracies.
Despite it, I vow to struggle...

For regaining the hidden truth, and sending everything back to zero...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE206373.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“你难道不知道……关于我……吗？”
我已经失去了所有关于我自己的记忆。

我的生活在某家医院重新开始 
伴随着美丽的经纪人。然而，
这平静的日子突然被打破了 
被一个超能力者……

精心策划的罪恶、血腥的谎言和……
两人之间的爱情擦肩而过。

他们的命运将因错综复杂的阴谋而改变。
尽管如此，我还是发誓要奋斗……

为了找回隐藏的真相，让一切归零……

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE206373.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
